links.outcome: Classification accuracy of full MLLM pipelines versus a trained vision encoder alone for knee OA
links.effect: A trained vision encoder alone outperformed full MLLM pipelines in classification accuracy. Fine-tuning the LLM gave no meaningful improvement over prompt-based guidance.
links.quote: In our classification task, a trained vision encoder alone could outperform full MLLM pipelines in classification accuracy and fine-tuning the LLM provided no meaningful improvement over prompt-based guidance.

unlisted_practices: Curating small class-balanced fine-tuning datasets rather than larger class-imbalanced ones (500 balanced vs 5,778 imbalanced images)
Prioritizing vision encoder optimization over LLM fine-tuning in multimodal architectures

screen.reason: Empirical study benchmarking multimodal LLM components versus vision encoders on knee osteoarthritis radiograph classification using retrospective OAI dataset without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
